reviews.title: Cooling is great, fans are quiet.
reviews.comment: This is by far the best option for the money if you're looking for an AIO. It works just as well as the 3 fan version, and looks great while doing so. I especially love the infinity mirror. Cpu temps stay low while gaming and the RGB is beautiful. Fans are also nice and quiet, even at high rpm.
reviews.author: Benjamin

reviews.title: Looks good, drops CPU temp, and unbelievably well priced.
reviews.comment: This AIO not only looks good, works really well, but also well priced. This is my first time purchasing and installing an AIO (building a PC at it too). The installation was simple, pain free, and was quick. I don't have a frame of reference to compare this to other AIOs in the market, but this AIO definitely worked as intended. My CPU temp dropped about 5-7C, better than my air CPU cooler. This AIO has great form factor, fantastic addressable RGB lighting, and the infinity mirror looked so good in my PC. A great upgrade from my bulky air cooler. Addressable means I can go ham with the lighting effects, and I did. Loving it so far. When it comes to price, I don't think there's anything remotely close to the price this AIO offered. Great value and would definitely consider buying this again if I ever buy another PC.
reviews.author: Zano Korellio

reviews.title: Great AIO for a reasonable price!
reviews.comment: Great AIO for the price very well made easy to install quiet running keeps my CPU at 35°c at a idle 50°c full load gaming. Function perfect out of the box. Fits good in front of my mid tower seems like the build is of quality parts looks good to. Thank you Thermalright.
reviews.author: Daniel Hoffman

reviews.title: Cheap and easy to install but barely any instructions on wires
reviews.comment: One major problem is that the instructions show an outdated picture and don't tell you what to do with the wires. You can find videos online but one wire in particular will not match your motherboard: The water pump wire. It only has 3 pin slots, and it is supposed to be connected to your PUMP or other power pins even though it looks different from the normal power pins on the rest of the rig.. so the wires are very confusing and have no real proper documentation. There is one image at the end showing "some" wires (certainly not all the RGB wires and power wires this thing has) and the image is very cryptic and its outdated, probably reused from a different product or something. If it wasn't for the poor documentation on the wires, i would give it 5 stars. Be aware that if you leave the pump power wire unconnected for some reason (because its separate from all the rest and you might think its an RGB wire you don't need or something since all the RGB cables are 3 pins just like the pump power wire) that the system will see the fans running because you plugged in the fan powers correctly but not know that the cooler is not working at all and your CPU will overheat.. since after all, the pump is off and no warnings will be given. They should add one little extra circuit for the wires so that if ANY of the power wires have no power, then NONE of the power is supplied to the fans or pump... that way the system wont even turn on or it will give audible warnings that no CPU fan is detected. Because in the current state of it's lack of documentation and many mixed RGB wires with power wires, you could simply not connect that extra pump wire thinking it's an RGB wire (which it looks like).
reviews.author: Michael Urvan

reviews.title: Easy Setup And Works FLAWLESSLY!!!
reviews.comment: I've been very nervous at the thought of upgrading my stock cooler for years now. I have a Ryzen 5700x and while gaming I was getting up to 94c TEMPS on my CPU with the stock cooler. So, the time was now to suck it up and give it a try. I was attracted to this AIO because price and positive reviews. The setup process was pretty straightforward and easy to mount. I appreciate the simplistic way of mounting the heatsink to the CPU. All I had to do was clip both side in and tighten 2 screws. After testing the CPU to see if the PC would power on, I noticed how powerful the fans were. I can feel the cool air. I put everything together and was eager to see if my temps improved and was excited to see my TEMPS in the 30s and 40s. With the stock CPU cooler, it idled at 55-60c. I booted up Diablo 4 1440p MAX settings and my temps were at around 60-64c. This is such an AMAZING cooler. I am so glad I gave this AIO a chance. If you are thinking about getting it and you are a beginner builder, then I recommend doing it.
reviews.author: Chris Rodriguez
